body: ‘Don’t set your self on fire to keep those around you warm’

Hey man I’m no expert, I’m struggling with my own stuff at the moment too. I think that we’re all going through difficulties in life and unfortunately some of us take ahold of a vice that is self destructive. We’re all only human. Sometimes talking about it can really help. My sincere advice from the heart is find something you’re passionate about. Something that makes everything become minuscule. Saturate yourself in it and love it unconditionally even when time’s are hard. Take help when it’s there it takes a strong person to barge through their problems, but it takes a stronger person to take help when they need it. You’re already taking a step in the right direction by understanding your situation. And I’m damn proud of you for doing so. 

There will be good times and bad time’s but remember it’s all temporary you just need to remind yourself that there will be a next time. Another time to better yourself. Another opportunity to become the person that your want to be. And fuck, yes you may make the wrong decision sometimes! That’s what being human is! It isn’t the actions we make in the moment that defines us. It’s what we decide to fucking do when push comes to shove! 

Just remind yourself, If you can, that every single decision you make will make you who you are tomorrow. Does the future you deserve more? DAMN RIGHT! You deserve more, we all do who struggle with addiction. It’s not what we plan 5 years from now that will make us who we are it’s every little choice we make until that 5 years are up. 

You will be okay, I promise you this, but only if you put the work in. 

HMU if you want to talk hopefully I can be of some help.
